g_ir.name: all_pairs_gap_linear_margin_regret_clamped_reweight_v2
g_ir.intuition: Preserve margin_regret_blend weighting but add explicit clamping and denominator epsilon guards to stabilize weights without tie-zone suppression.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']
    mask = objective[:, :, None] < objective[:, None, :]
    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    eps = 1e-6
    gap = objective[b_idx, loser_idx] - objective[b_idx, winner_idx]
    instance_obj_mad = feature_cache['instance_obj_mad'].clamp_min(eps)
    gap_scaled = gap / instance_obj_mad[b_idx]
    margin_abs = (log_prob[b_idx, winner_idx] - log_prob[b_idx, loser_idx]).abs()
    instance_log_prob_std = feature_cache['instance_log_prob_std'].clamp_min(eps)
    margin_norm = margin_abs / instance_log_prob_std[b_idx]
    instance_regret_mean = feature_cache['instance_regret_mean'].clamp_min(eps)
    regret_scale = instance_regret_mean[b_idx]
    raw_weight = gap_scaled * margin_norm * regret_scale
    clamp_lo = float(extra.get('clamp_lo', 0.2))
    clamp_hi = float(extra.get('clamp_hi', 2.5))
    weight_clamped = raw_weight.clamp(min=clamp_lo, max=clamp_hi)
    weight_clean = weight_clamped.nan_to_num(nan=clamp_lo, posinf=clamp_hi, neginf=clamp_lo)
    # Additional clamp to handle any extreme values post nan_to_num
    weight_final = weight_clean.clamp(min=clamp_lo, max=clamp_hi)
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weight_final, meta={
        'builder': 'all_pairs',
        'geometry_family': 'dense_all_pairs',
        'cap_family': 'uncapped_full',
        'weight_family': 'margin_regret_blend',
        'constraint_family': 'clamp_eps_guard'
    })
